mapper.select: SELECT student.NAME FROM TB_STUDENT student WHERE student.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND student.STATUS = 'Y' AND student.DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TEACHER_STUDENT relation JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS access_row ON access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND access_row.STATUS = 'Y' AND access_row.REVOKED_AT IS NULL WHERE relation.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND relation.STATUS = 'Y' AND relation.DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID, relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID, teacher.NAME AS TEACHER_NAME, location.LOCATION_ID, location.NAME AS LOCATION_NAME FROM TB_TEACHER_STUDENT relation JOIN TB_TEACHER teacher ON teacher.TEACHER_ID = relation.TEACHER_ID JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS access_row ON access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND access_row.STATUS = 'Y' AND access_row.REVOKED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION link ON link.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND link.STATUS = 'Y' AND link.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_LOCATION location ON location.LOCATION_ID = link.LOCATION_ID AND location.STATUS = 'Y' AND location.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE relation.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND relation.STATUS = 'Y' AND relation.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY teacher.NAME, access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID, location.NAME, location.LOCATION_ID

SELECT relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID, student.STUDENT_ID, student.NAME AS STUDENT_NAME FROM TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS access_row JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT relation ON relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND relation.STATUS = 'Y' AND relation.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_STUDENT student ON student.STUDENT_ID = relation.STUDENT_ID AND student.STATUS = 'Y' AND student.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID = #{teacherStudentAccessId} AND access_row.STATUS = 'Y' AND access_row.REVOKED_AT IS NULL

SELECT enrollment.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID, curriculum.CURRICULUM_ID, curriculum.NAME AS CURRICULUM_NAME, curriculum.DISPLAY_ORDER AS CURRICULUM_DISPLAY_ORDER FROM TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS access_row JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT relation ON relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND relation.STATUS = 'Y' AND relation.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION link ON link.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND link.STATUS = 'Y' AND link.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_STUDENT_CURRICULUM enrollment ON enrollment.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID = link.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID AND enrollment.STATUS = 'Y' AND enrollment.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_CURRICULUM curriculum ON curriculum.CURRICULUM_ID = enrollment.CURRICULUM_ID AND curriculum.STATUS = 'Y' AND curriculum.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE access_row.TEACHER_STUDENT_ACCESS_ID = #{teacherStudentAccessId} AND access_row.STATUS = 'Y' AND access_row.REVOKED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY curriculum.DISPLAY_ORDER, enrollment.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID

SELECT category.CURRICULUM_ID, category.CATEGORY_ID, category.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(content.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID) AS TOTAL_CONTENT_COUNT FROM TB_CATEGORY category LEFT JOIN TB_CONTENT_DETAIL content ON content.CATEGORY_ID = category.CATEGORY_ID AND content.STATUS = 'Y' AND content.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE category.STATUS = 'Y' AND category.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND category.CURRICULUM_ID IN
#{curriculumId}
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY category.CURRICULUM_ID, category.CATEGORY_ID, category.NAME, category.DISPLAY_ORDER ORDER BY category.CURRICULUM_ID, category.DISPLAY_ORDER, category.CATEGORY_ID

SELECT monitoring.MONITORING_ID, monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID, category.CATEGORY_ID, content.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID, content.NAME AS CONTENT_NAME, content.TARGET_BPM, content.YOUTUBE_URL, monitoring.CURRENT_BPM, monitoring.PROGRESS_STATUS FROM TB_STUDENT_MONITORING monitoring JOIN TB_STUDENT_CURRICULUM enrollment ON enrollment.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID = monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID AND enrollment.STATUS = 'Y' AND enrollment.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_CONTENT_DETAIL content ON content.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID = monitoring.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID AND content.STATUS = 'Y' AND content.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_CATEGORY category ON category.CATEGORY_ID = content.CATEGORY_ID AND category.CURRICULUM_ID = enrollment.CURRICULUM_ID AND category.STATUS = 'Y' AND category.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE monitoring.STATUS = 'Y' AND monitoring.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID IN
#{studentCurriculumId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID, category.DISPLAY_ORDER, category.CATEGORY_ID, content.DISPLAY_ORDER, content.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID, monitoring.MONITORING_ID

SELECT homework.HOMEWORK_ID, monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID, monitoring.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID, homework.HOMEWORK_CONTENT, homework.DEADLINE, homework.IS_COMPLETED, homework.FEEDBACK FROM TB_HOMEWORK homework JOIN TB_STUDENT_MONITORING monitoring ON monitoring.MONITORING_ID = homework.MONITORING_ID AND monitoring.STATUS = 'Y' AND monitoring.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE homework.STATUS = 'Y' AND homework.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID IN
#{studentCurriculumId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY homework.CREATED_AT, homework.HOMEWORK_ID
